# Tasks

## Fix the reaper

The blade sticks when it turns.
Oil the hinge first.

## Paint the barn

Red, like last year.

steps.line: * Given "## Fix the reaper" is folded and the selection is in it

expect.that: (.before.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.text == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | any(.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded[]; .offset == $h and .line == "## Fix the reaper")

expect.why: the heading shows its folded marker
the fold hid text the view showed before it

expect.that: (.before.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.text == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | .folded.json.sections.notebook.selection | .location >= $h and .location + .length <= $h + ("## Fix the reaper" | length)
expect.why: the selection is in the folded heading

steps.line: * When the user chooses View > Unfold Heading
* Then the view shows the same text as before the fold

expect.why: the view shows every paragraph it showed before the fold, at the same offsets, and nothing else

steps.line: * And "## Fix the reaper" shows no folded marker

expect.that: (.before.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.text == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | .unfolded.json.sections.notebook | any(.drawn[]; .offset == $h and .text == "## Fix the reaper") and all(.markers[]; .heading != $h)
expect.why: the heading is on screen and no folded marker shows beside it
